overview.title: Fleet overview
overview.description: Workers, claims and cells for the selected tenant over the last hour.

alerts.claims_being_reconciled: {n} claims being reconciled with the board

empty.title: No workers registered yet
empty.body: Start a worker with the cell's join token and it appears here within one heartbeat.

error.title: Couldn't load the overview
error.body: The API returned 503 for /v1/overview. Nothing is lost — workers keep claiming while the console reconnects.

denied.title: You don't have access to this tenant
denied.body: Your role has no grant on this tenant. Ask an owner to add you.

overview.cellLine: {workers} of your workers here · {tenants} tenants on this cell · capacity {capacity}

alertDetails.stale_workers: See Workers for which ones and since when.
alertDetails.sessions_need_attention: See Accounts: expiring, expired or waiting for a one-time code.
alertDetails.claims_being_reconciled: The act's reply was lost; the reconciler is asking the board what happened.

overview.reconcilingNote: The act's reply was lost; the reconciler asks the board what happened
overview.otherCells: {n} other cells run other tenants in this deployment.

workers.title: Workers
workers.description: Every browser worker, its mode, its account and its last heartbeat.

empty.title: No workers in this tenant
empty.body: Workers register themselves on start. Check the cell's join token and the worker logs.

error.title: Couldn't load workers
error.body: Request to /v1/workers timed out after 10 s. Try again; the fleet is unaffected.

denied.title: Workers are restricted
denied.body: Viewing workers needs the operator role.

accounts.title: Accounts & sessions
accounts.description: Board accounts the claimers act as, with session freshness and OTP channel.
accounts.credentialNote: Passwords and cookies are encrypted at rest and never shown here.

empty.title: No accounts connected
empty.body: Add a board account; its password is encrypted and never shown again.

error.title: Couldn't load accounts
error.body: The session service did not respond. Sessions keep refreshing in the background.

denied.title: Accounts are owner-only
denied.body: Only owners can see board accounts and sessions.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Which loads each account group may claim. Filters are data, versioned on every edit.

empty.title: No filters yet
empty.body: Without a filter, watchers detect loads but nothing is claimed.

error.title: Couldn't load filters
error.body: Filter service returned 500. Existing filters stay active.

denied.title: Filters are restricted
denied.body: Editing and viewing filters needs the operator role.

schedules.title: Schedules
schedules.description: When the fleet is allowed to act, per timezone.

empty.title: No schedules
empty.body: With no schedule the fleet watches but never acts.

denied.title: Schedules are restricted
denied.body: Viewing schedules needs the operator role.

claims.title: Claims
claims.description: Every detected load and what happened to it, with the full state timeline.

empty.title: No claims in this window
empty.body: Watchers are running but no load matched a filter in the last hour.

error.title: Couldn't load claims
error.body: The claims query was cancelled. Try again.

denied.title: Claims are restricted
denied.body: Viewing claims needs the operator role.

latency.title: Latency
latency.description: Each stage measured separately — publish→detect is never averaged into detect→action.
latency.note: Computed from the mock claims' own timestamps (nearest-rank). Real numbers publish after the Phase 5 load test.

empty.title: No completed claims yet
empty.body: Percentiles appear once claims reach each stage.

denied.title: Latency is restricted
denied.body: Viewing metrics needs the operator role.

latency.liveNote: Measured from the claims' own timestamps over the last {window} (nearest-rank). Stages with no samples show 0.

crawl.title: Crawl jobs
crawl.description: Crawls defined as data, with per-cycle item counts and anomaly alarms.

empty.title: No crawl jobs
empty.body: Define a crawl as data: seeds, selectors and politeness.

error.title: Couldn't load crawl jobs
error.body: The crawl service did not respond.

denied.title: Crawl jobs are restricted
denied.body: Viewing crawls needs the operator role.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Append-only. Every mutation and every claim action is recorded.
audit.appendOnly: Append-only · cannot be edited or deleted from the console

empty.title: No audit entries
empty.body: Entries appear as soon as anyone changes anything.

error.title: Couldn't load the audit log
error.body: The audit store did not respond.

denied.title: Audit log is owner-only
denied.body: Only owners can read the audit log.

error.title: Couldn't load settings

denied.title: Settings are owner-only
denied.body: Only owners can change tenant settings.

charts.lineKeys: {title}. Use the left and right arrow keys to read each point.

notBuilt.title: Not built yet
notBuilt.body: This screen is a design preview. The live system does not run crawl jobs yet; see the public roadmap.

otp.label: One-time code for {account}
otp.sent: Code sent to the waiting worker
otp.note: The code goes straight to the worker waiting for it; it is not stored or logged.

demo.title: Demo controls
demo.intro: This tenant runs against the mock freight board. Start a burst of loads or add trouble, and watch the claims and the timeline react.
demo.signInToControl: Sign in with the public demo login (on the sign-in page) to use these controls.
demo.resetNote: Everything returns to the calm preset {t} after the last change.
